content: {"praised": ["Fun, humorous mystery with Shaggy becoming a bad‑ass hero.", "Relaxing spa getaway setting adds a light tone.", "Good pacing for a family‑friendly adventure.", "Engaging characters and clear plot twists.", "Enjoyable music and catchy opening song."], "criticized": ["Story feels worse than earlier Scooby films.", "Shaggy’s barroom brawl with thugs is out of place.", "Villains become too appealing, undermining the tone.", "Pacing feels agonizingly slow in parts.", "Tone shifts from easy‑going to darker." ]}
